steps.clue: Feed the three dragons to obtain the Wrath of the Ancients.
Complete the elemental upgrades for the Wrath of the Ancients.
Shoot four wisps with an upgraded bow before time runs out.
Travel to the past for the soul canister, fuses and safe code.
Open the safe, install the Tesla fuses, then complete both memory games.
Use the Death Ray to bring down Dempsey’s capsule, then collect the Vril Device.
Shoot the wisps a second time and return to the past for the stone tablet.
Complete the Keeper’s four soul circles, then place the soul canister in the returned MPD.
Place the Ragnarok DG-4s around the MPD to enter the boss fight.
Defeat the Keeper, then use the Summoning Key to destroy the Moon.
